official.deadline_note: No institutional deadline separate from the programme's is published; the scholarship regulations state 'Applications close on 1 October for the following year tenure'. The published 2026 round opened 1 August 2026 and closed 1 October 2026.
official.application_cycle: 2026 round - applications open 1 August 2026, close 1 October 2026, for the following year's tenure
official.status_note: The official scholarship page lists 'Status: Closed' for the round that opened 1 August 2026 and closed 1 October 2026; Massey's guidance states outcomes take up to 6 weeks from the closing date. No 2027 dates are published yet.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Regulations: 'payment of tuition and non-tuition fees to a maximum of 36 months of full-time study' (60 months for part-time). 'Tuition fees will be paid at the domestic rate for the doctoral course only.' Additional coursework during candidature (including provisional-year coursework for the confirmation event) is not covered.

official.citizenship_residency: Open to New Zealand and international students; recipients must be based in NZ for the tenure of the scholarship.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the regulations state the scholarships 'are open to New Zealand and international students'. Tuition fees are paid at the domestic rate and medical and travel insurance for international students is not included in the value.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Doctoral programmes only: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), Doctor of Clinical Psychology (DClinPsych) or Doctor of Social Work (DSW); named variants exist for Maori and Pacific doctoral candidates.
official.research_requirement: A research outline of the proposed project (200-1000 words) covering the key disciplinary area(s), aims and significance, and theoretical and methodological frameworks; the research must align with the strategic priorities of the University, College and supervisor(s).
official.duration: Three years' duration (up to a maximum of 36 months for full-time candidates; up to 60 months for part-time candidates)
official.description: Massey University Doctoral Scholarships are awarded to high-achieving students to provide financial support for their doctoral study, and Massey describes the award as 'a scholarship for a stipend plus fees' - a $30,000 annual stipend plus payment of tuition and non-tuition fees. The scholarships are open to New Zealand and international doctoral candidates in the PhD, DClinPsych and DSW, with named scholarships for Maori and Pacific doctoral candidates.
official.program_type: University doctoral scholarship (postgraduate, PhD or doctorate, research)
official.english_requirement: Via Massey's doctoral admission requirements that underpin eligibility: IELTS (Academic) 6.5 overall with no band less than 6.0; TOEFL iBT 90 overall with 20 in writing; or PTE 58 overall with 50 in each communicative skill; exemption if the qualifying degree was completed in New Zealand, Australia, Canada, Ireland, the United Kingdom or the United States. English evidence is valid for 2 years from completion.

applicant_utility.summary: This Massey award pairs a $30,000 annual stipend with tuition and compulsory fees paid at the domestic rate for up to three years of full-time doctoral study, so tuition is covered but your supervisor relationship is the make-or-break element: your primary supervisor must complete the official Supervisor Support Template before you can submit. Selection weighs a GPA of 7.0 (A-) or equivalent alongside how closely your project matches University, College and supervisor research strategy, so a merely strong transcript without strategic alignment is not enough. International students should note the stipend is set at NZ cost-of-living expectations, medical and travel insurance is explicitly excluded, and recipients must be based in New Zealand for the whole tenure.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral candidates with an A-/7.0 average and a confirmed or near-confirmed Massey supervisor whose research sits squarely inside a Massey College strategy.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm a conditional or unconditional offer of place in a PhD, DClinPsych or DSW at least 4-6 weeks before 1 October, as admission processing needs a minimum of 4 weeks
Brief your primary supervisor early and get the Supervisor Support Template completed and signed, since it must be uploaded with the application
Draft the 200-1000 word research outline against the actual University, College and supervisor strategy documents, naming disciplinary area, aims, significance, theory and method
Check StudyLink: a scholarship can affect student allowance or loan entitlement, and you must notify StudyLink of the award
Model a budget around the $30,000 stipend plus insurance and visa costs if you are an international applicant
common_rejection_risks: Applying before an offer of place is secured, or leaving admission so late that the 4-week processing window pushes past the closing date
A research outline that reads generically and never connects the project to stated University, College or supervisor strategic priorities
GPA below the 7.0 (A-) threshold with no equivalent evidence to argue the case
Missing or incomplete Supervisor Support Template, which is mandatory at upload
Assuming an April closing date - the currently published regulations list only 1 October
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International medical and travel insurance (explicitly excluded) and student visa costs; any additional coursework taken during candidature; living costs above the $30,000 stipend; for part-time candidates the stipend is $18,000 per annum.
document_audit: Only one file can be uploaded per upload box in the Massey Student Portal, so combine multiple evidence documents into a single PDF before uploading
The Supervisor Support Template must be completed by your primary supervisor, not by you, and uploaded in the portal at the point of application
The research outline has a hard 200-1000 word range and must name the disciplinary area, aims, significance, theoretical and methodological frameworks
Evidence of English proficiency is valid for only 2 years, so book IELTS/TOEFL/PTE early enough that results are current at admission
alerts: The published 2026 round closed 1 October 2026; the regulations state applications close on 1 October for the following year's tenure, so plan for a roughly 1 August to 1 October window and watch the scholarship page for the next round rather than relying on older references to an April closing
Recipients must be based in NZ for the entire tenure - remote offshore study is not compatible with the award

The scholarship cannot be held with the Massey University Alumni Doctoral (including Maori and Pacific Alumni) scholarships, and co-tenure with other awards is capped at $25,000 per annum with commensurate reduction above that
Funding stops on thesis submission for examination - there is no writing-up allowance, and remaining tenure is lost
Progress is policed: timely 6-monthly reports and passing the Confirmation of Registration event within expected timeframes are conditions of continued payment
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure a doctoral offer of place (allow 4+ weeks), have your supervisor complete the Support Template, then apply in the Massey Student Portal during the open window, upload the research outline and template as PDFs, agree to the terms and submit; Massey can take up to 6 weeks after closing to advise outcomes.
